hook.name: GlueHook
hook.description: A Uniswap v4 hook implementing a buyback-and-burn pot per pool: in beforeSwap, it absorbs sells of a designated 'main' token at the pool's exact execution price via a delta return (shield); in afterSwap, it triggers capped market buys of the main token after each purchase via a nested self-swap (pump). Also manages an optional auto-compounding LP fee program per pool.
